sdc_text:
set sdc_version 2.2
set_units -time ns -capacitance pF

create_clock -name clk -period 10.000 [get_ports clk]

set_clock_latency -source 0.5 [get_clocks clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks clk]
set_clock_uncertainty 0.1 [get_clocks clk]

set_input_delay -clock clk -max 2.0 [get_ports data_in*]
set_input_delay -clock clk -min 0.5 [get_ports data_in*]
set_input_delay -clock clk -max 1.0 [get_ports reset]
set_input_delay -clock clk -min 0.2 [get_ports reset]

set_output_delay -clock clk -max 3.0 [get_ports data_out*]
set_output_delay -clock clk -min 0.8 [get_ports data_out*]

set_driving_cell -lib_cell BUF_X1 [get_ports data_in*]
set_driving_cell -lib_cell BUF_X1 [get_ports reset]
set_input_transition 0.2 [get_ports data_in*]
set_input_transition 0.2 [get_ports reset]

set_load 0.05 [get_ports data_out*]

set_max_fanout 20 [all_inputs]
set_max_transition 0.2 [all_nets]

set_ideal_network [get_ports reset]

set_operating_conditions -max_lib typical -min_lib typical
